page: Microsoft Azure D128plds_v7 is an arm64-based virtual machine belonging to the Dpldsv7 series, running under the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance is configured with 128 dedicated vCPUs and 256.0 GB of system memory, providing a ratio of 2.0 GB RAM per core. This architecture focuses on high multi-threaded computational density for applications that do not require standard or expanded memory configurations. The system includes no hardware accelerators or GPUs.

A key component of this virtual machine configuration is the inclusion of 7,560 GB of direct-attached local NVMe SSD storage. In addition to high-capacity local scratch disk space, the instance supports Azure Premium Storage for external managed disk attachments. Network and interface configurations do not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses, necessitating standard virtual network routing or address allocation policies.

The 1:2 memory-to-core profile provides an efficient resource footprint for parallel computing tasks where CPU core saturation takes precedence over per-thread memory footprint. However, environments with extensive in-memory working sets may encounter memory constraints under heavy concurrency. Microsoft Azure D128plds_v7 fits workloads such as large-scale build and CI/CD clusters, compute-focused distributed analytics, media transcoding, extract-transform-load (ETL) processing, and parallel batch operations requiring fast local caching.
